name: pi-do-browser-ext
description: Chrome side-panel browser agent whose agent loop runs on Pi inside a Cloudflare Durable Object

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ext.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.worker:size: rm -rf dist/worker && npm run build:worker && node node_modules/agent-core/tools/worker-size.js dist/worker --max-gzip-kib 800
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/wrangler-config.ts --check && npm run build:extension && npm run worker:size
